title: [CDCSDK] [PG Parity] Before Image + Batch delete, causing node to go unreachable
body:
Jira Link: [DB-11533](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-11533)
### Description

Please refer slack thread in JIRA

Tracking 2 observations here:

1. When there was a batch delete, the node went unreachable. 

![Screenshot 2024-05-30 at 10 31 55 PM (1)](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/assets/109518123/568dda53-1226-450d-875b-cc95a00875bc)

There was spike in memory which caused node to become unreachable

2. Node came back up after 10 mins, but CDC never streamed those deleted rows

![Screenshot 2024-05-30 at 9 18 18 PM (1)](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/assets/109518123/cc26227e-aa3e-434d-9381-db90480267b4)

Please note, we have flush and compaction running in separate thread as well.


### Source connector version

fourpointfour/ybdb-debezium:0.9
